headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. Strictly Monospace for an elite, terminal-inspired cyberpunk feel. Use tracking-tighter for huge headers, tracking-widest for small labels.

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for reading paragraphs and descriptions.

colors.strategy: Archetype 7: Electric & Neon. Deepest void base (#0a0e17) to make the dual-accents (Green for SEC, Cyan for DEV) pop. Rely on 1px borders and intense text-shadow glows instead of flat colored blocks.

surfaces.name: Terminal Chrome
surfaces.classes: bg-[#111623] border border-white/10 hover:border-[#00ff9d]/50 transition-colors duration-300 relative overflow-hidden group

textures.name: Matrix Grid
textures.css: background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 30px 30px;

textures.name: CRT Scanlines
textures.css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.15), rgba(0,0,0,0.15) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 2px);

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-6, p-8, py-24. Cards must have internal p-8. Massive gap-12 between sections.
layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Layout: Split or overlapping. Kinetic typography masked line-by-line reveal on load. A floating interactive terminal widget on the side/bottom.
layouts.projectsGrid: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Mix 2-span and 1-span cards for asymmetry. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
layouts.skillsSplit: Two vertical pillars representing BUILD (Cyan) vs SECURE (Green). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12. Deeply contrasting columns.
layouts.sections: Numbered chapters (e.g., '01 // HERO'). Always left-align section headers. Add a left border (border-l-2) matching the section's dominant accent color.

motion.scrolling: Smooth momentum scrolling using standard CSS or lenis setup.
motion.interactions: Hover states must include slight lift (-translate-y-1) and neon border glow. Terminal text should have a blinking cursor step animation.
motion.reveal: Scroll-triggered staggered fade-in + slide-up for all sections using framer-motion.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular, bordered with glowing accent text. hover:bg-[#00ff9d]/10 hover:text-[#00ff9d] transition-all. Minimalist but high impact.
buttons.secondary: Ghost button with underline or arrow animation on hover.

components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text 'text-8xl font-black text-transparent [-webkit-text-stroke:1px_#334155]'. Words: 'BUILD // BREAK // SECURE // OPTIMIZE'.
components.badges: Tiny tags inside project cards. Cyan text/bg for DEV. Green text/bg for SEC. Split gradient for DEV+SEC.
components.terminalWidget: A fake CLI window with standard macOS traffic lights (red/yellow/green dots). Inside, a typing effect rotating through mock commands like 'nmap -sV target.sys', 'docker-compose up -d', 'nuclei -u target.com'.

images.description: Dramatic dark portrait of developer for the ABOUT section.
Close up of server room with green/blue lights, ideal for 'Government Infrastructure Security Audit' project card background.
Matrix digital rain for 'sectools.py' or 'DoitYourSelf OS' project.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw React and Tailwind to build highly customized layouts. Avoid pre-built Shadcn structures if they restrict the Tetris Grid or terminal aesthetic. However, use Shadcn forms/inputs for the Contact form.
The Hero section must feature an animated typing effect rotating through the provided roles.
Implement the background using a fixed positioned div with the Matrix Grid texture and radial gradient to fade out the edges.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
Projects section should utilize a Bento-style grid. 1 main project spanning multiple columns, others single column.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use Retro-Futurism Glass.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
